# DCO — Developer Certificate of Origin

This repository enforces the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/) (DCO) on all contributions.

Every commit must include a `Signed-off-by:` trailer matching the commit author:

```bash
git commit -s
```

By signing off, you certify (per the DCO text) that you wrote the contribution or otherwise have the right to submit it, and that you license it under this project's license (AGPL-3.0-or-later).

Pull requests are checked by the DCO app; commits without a valid sign-off cannot be merged. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full contribution guide.
